components.name: Acceleration
components.doc:
Acceleration is an entity's rate of change of velocity, applied once per
tick.

X.description: X is the horizontal acceleration, in world units per tick squared.

Y.description: Y is the vertical acceleration, in world units per tick squared.

components.name: Armor
components.doc: Armor is a Boss-only required component, making Boss richer than Hero.

Value.description: Value is the damage absorbed from each hit.

components.name: Companion
components.doc:
Companion is a readonly (value) component: NewEntity/Set store a copy,
and Get/Each copy it back out.

Attachment.description: Attachment is what the companion carries, or null when nothing.

Name.description: Name is the companion's display name.

components.name: Follow
components.doc:
Follow makes an entity move after another object. Target is an entity
reference: in a level file it is the "id" of the followed object, and null
means nobody.

components.name: Health
components.doc:
Health is an entity's hit points. The entity is dead when Current reaches
zero.

Current.description: Current is the remaining hit points.

Max.description: Max is the upper bound Current is healed up to.

components.name: Hitbox
components.doc:
Hitbox is an axis-aligned box, relative to the entity's position, used for
collision. Its identity is declared on the type: it is "game:Hitbox" in
data files, in the same group as the gametypes components.

Height.description: Height is the box height, in world units.

OffsetX.description:
OffsetX is the horizontal distance from the entity's position to the
box origin.

OffsetY.description:
OffsetY is the vertical distance from the entity's position to the box
origin.

Width.description: Width is the box width, in world units.

components.name: Score
components.doc:
Score is a component no object uses yet. +game:component on the type puts
it into the GOD, types.Components() and the god-doc output anyway, so it
can be documented and linked before an object adopts it.

Points.description: Points is the score so far.

components.name: State
components.doc: State is an entity's coarse behavioral state.

Active.description: Active reports whether the entity takes part in the simulation.

Kind.description: Kind names the behavior the entity is in, e.g. "idle" or "attacking".

components.name: Transform
components.doc: Transform is an entity's position in the world.

X.description: X is the horizontal position, in world units.

Y.description: Y is the vertical position, in world units.

components.name: Vel
components.doc: Vel is an entity's velocity.

X.description: X is the horizontal velocity, in world units per tick.

Y.description: Y is the vertical velocity, in world units per tick.

components.name: Weapon
components.doc:
Weapon is an optional offensive component. Entities without it cannot
attack.

Ammo.description: Ammo is the number of shots left.

Damage.description: Damage is the hit points removed from a target per hit.

objects.doc:
Common is the set of components every moving thing in the game shares. It
is embedded by the other objects.
